summary: Phase 1 & 2 SaaS multi-tenant e2e validation. Backend: 10/10 new test_saas.py PASS + 63/64 across full suite (1 transient network timeout, not a real failure). Frontend: end-to-end UI tested across STARTER/CLINIC/COMPLETE/TRIAL clinics — registration, onboarding, ClinicProvider context, SubscriptionBanner, FeatureGate locking on visit tabs, sidebar locked-nav indicators, /billing/plans, /billing/checkout. All gating logic works correctly. Two minor UI/UX issues found that the main agent should address before sign-off.

ui_bugs.issue: Sidebar + mobile header clinic name falls back to hardcoded 'Body Lab Bali' when branding.clinic_name from /api/settings is empty. After registering a NEW clinic or logging in as owner@cantikbeauty.id (Cantik Beauty), the sidebar still displays 'Body Lab Bali' instead of the actual clinic name from ClinicProvider. Multi-tenant UX flaw — every tenant sees the legacy clinic name. Fix: replace fallback chain with `branding?.clinic_name || clinic?.name || 'ClinicOS'`.
ui_bugs.selector: aside .font-display:first-of-type (currently shows 'Body Lab Bali' for ALL clinics)

ui_bugs.issue: No data-testid='current-plan-badge' element rendered. The spec says 'current plan shows badge'. While testing as Starter owner on /billing/plans, the testid was not found. Visually it may exist as a styled chip, but the testid is missing which blocks automated regression. Add `data-testid="current-plan-badge"` on the badge element.

Missing data-testid attributes on key elements: bank account block, total amount, and 'Submit proof' button. Page renders correct content (BCA/Mandiri accounts, plan price Rp 1.200.000, unique code 360, total Rp 1.200.360) but lacks testids: bank-info / checkout-total / payment-submit. Required for E2E + future regression.

action_items: Fix AppShell.jsx fallback for clinic name to use clinic?.name from useClinic() instead of literal 'Body Lab Bali' — multi-tenant correctness.
Add data-testid='current-plan-badge' to BillingPlansPage current-plan indicator.
Add data-testid attributes to BillingCheckoutPage: bank-info, checkout-total, payment-submit (helps both QA and future Phase-3 backend wiring).
(Optional) Wire register/onboarding to also persist clinic_name into /api/settings (branding) on first save so the sidebar pulls a proper name even without explicit branding edit.
critical_code_review_comments: Multi-tenant identity leak: every tenant's sidebar reads 'Body Lab Bali' due to hardcoded fallback in AppShell.jsx — this is a SaaS-blocking UX bug masking that ClinicProvider data is actually loaded correctly.
saas.py public_clinic_view + get_clinic_features correctly compute features set; tested via /api/clinics/me returning expected feature lists per plan (verified for starter/clinic/complete/trial).

ClinicProvider in /app/frontend/src/lib/clinic.js silently swallows errors on /clinics/me failure (setClinic(null)). If 401/network blip occurs the app rehydrates with clinic=null and hasFeature returns true (optimistic) — could let Starter users into locked tabs briefly. Consider showing a loading state until refresh resolves.

ExpiryGate behavior was NOT physically tested (no expired clinic in DB and request said skip if not feasible). Code review confirms clinic_is_readonly returns True for expired/suspended/trial-past, and frontend ExpiryGate.jsx renders when clinic.readonly is true — logic looks correct but recommend adding a backend admin endpoint or seed flag to flip a clinic into expired status for QA.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_saas.py (new — 10 tests covering plans, registration, seeded logins, multi-tenant isolation, trial countdown)

success_rate.backend: 100% on SaaS tests (10/10). Full suite 63/64 — single failure is a transient connect-timeout in pre-existing test_admin_settings.py::test_persist_branding (not caused by this iteration).
success_rate.frontend: 92% — all flows functionally correct (register/onboarding/banner/FeatureGate/sidebar locks/plans/checkout). Two MEDIUM cosmetic-testability issues + one HIGH tenant-name fallback bug.

test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md: owner@cantikbeauty.id (starter), owner@glowclinic.id (clinic), owner@luminabali.id (complete), owner@renaskin.id (trial). Also registered a fresh trial clinic via /register form. All logins OK; super_admin role confirmed for clinic owners.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST clinics through /api/auth/register-clinic during pytest (test_register_clinic_creates_owner_and_trial uses unique uuid-based emails like test_xxxxxx@example.com) and one e2e_xxxxxx@example.com clinic from Playwright register flow. These trial clinics remain in DB; harmless (no /api endpoint to bulk-delete clinics yet).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend SaaS layer is solid — re-run /app/backend/tests/test_saas.py for regression. Frontend flows verified: register→onboarding→trial-banner, Starter visit tabs LOCK clinical/therapist/treatments/mapping (photos OPEN), Complete unlocks all, Clinic plan shows audit_log lock in sidebar, super_admin sees Billing & Plan nav, /billing/plans → /billing/checkout?plan=xxx works. Three remaining items above for main agent. ExpiryGate not exercised due to no expired tenant — main agent can verify by manually flipping a clinic's subscription.status to 'expired' in Mongo and reloading.
rca_of_the_issue: Sidebar clinic-name fallback bug: AppShell.jsx pre-dates the SaaS migration. It reads branding from /api/settings (legacy single-tenant settings doc) and uses literal 'Body Lab Bali' when missing. New clinics get a settings doc seeded by register-clinic but DEFAULT_SETTINGS likely has no clinic_name field, so fallback always wins. Quick fix: change line 59 & 137 to `branding?.clinic_name || clinic?.name || 'ClinicOS'` using clinic from useClinic().
